purpose: Compare multiple numeric series across categories.

rawDataContract.notes: Rows may be wide or tidy. The model chooses category and grouped numeric fields.

modelInstructions: Use when grouped comparison matters more than time trend.
Keep grouped series count small enough for readable bars.
Default x-axis and y-axis tick labels should use 10px font size, matching bar-line charts.
Place x-axis labels close to the x-axis baseline; default label baseline offset should be around 20px below the plot area, not the older 26px spacing.

X-axis labels should be displayed in full when measured label widths fit without overlap; only sample labels when full display would overlap, and sample by measured text width plus a small gap instead of fixed first/middle/last rules.
Hide the legend when the normalized payload contains only one series; show it by default for two or more series.
When shown, legend styling should match bar-line charts: 10px text, 8px circular markers, compact row gaps, and labels only.
Include a y-axis description when the metric name is available; use axis.label/title/name/description and place it above the right or left y-axis ticks.

For right-side y-axes, align the y-axis description to the same right edge as the y-axis tick labels, and allow the description text to extend leftward into the chart area instead of reserving extra right margin.
Tooltip should sit near the first gridline but not too high; use a compact vertical gap around 10px.
Do not add viewport or screen safety margins inside the component; component padding and default left/right plot margins should be zero unless needed for axis tick labels or explicit user styling.
Right-axis tick labels should be measured and right-aligned close to the plot with a small plot-to-label gap.

Choose axis bounds from the actual finite data and the zero baseline, then place gridCount evenly spaced horizontal grid lines including both bounds (default five lines, four intervals). A tiny value across zero must not create a large empty band. Keep measured first/last category labels completely inside the SVG while sampling crowded labels.
